newsitem.title: UK: NTT plans $500 million 5-year bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: NTT plans $500 million 5-year bond - dealers.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) plans to issue a $500 million five-year Eurobond this week, syndicate managers said on Monday.
The mandate for the deal was likely to be awarded on Tuesday, with launch expected soon after.
Spread talk was in the high single digit basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, bankers said.
In November, NTT issued a $300 million five-year bond via ABN AMRO Hoare Govett and J.P. Morgan, which was priced to yield 11 b.p. over Treasuries.
NTT has triple-A ratings from Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's Corp rating agencies.
